Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application stands disposed of.
3. This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 0432/2021 u/s 498A/406 IPC dated 03.09.2021 registered at PS Dwarka South.
4. The parties have arrived at a settlement dated 09.09.2022 before the Supreme Court Mediation Centre 5.
As per the settlement, Rs. 5 lakhs was to be paid to respondent No. 2.
Rs. 4 lakhs

had already been paid and Rs. 1 lakh is paid today vide DD No. 508815 dated 21.03.2023 drawn on ICICI Bank to respondent No. 2.
6.
The petitioner is present in Court and is identified by Mr. Bajaj, Adv.

Respondent No. 2 is also present and is identified by Ms. Thakur, Adv.

sentences.text: The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement out of their own free will, without any threat, pressure, coercion or undue influence.

8. However, clause 2 of the settlement reads as under:
"II. In full and final settlement of all claims of the Petitioner, whether it be towards maintenance of the Petitioner and the minor child (past, present and future),
alimony, stridhan, belongings, or any other ground whatsoever, the Respondent has agreed."
9.
The same is contrary to the judgment of 'Ganesh vs. Sudhir Kumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787].

entities.text: Ganesh vs. Sudhir Kumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner has given an affidavit, wherein it has been stated that the settlement shall not come in the way of the rights of the minor child, namely Kaustab Singh claiming his rights of maintenance, inheritance, matrimonial and educational expenses, etc. against either of the parents.
The said affidavit is taken on record.

10. It is directed that this order as well as the settlement shall not come in the way of the minor child claiming his legal rights and remedies with respect to maintenance, inheritance, education and marriage expenses, etc. against either of the parents.
11. With these directions, FIR No. 0432/2021 u/s 498A/406 IPC dated 03.09.2021 registered at PS Dwarka South, is hereby quashed.
12. The petition is disposed of.
JASMEET SINGH, J MARCH 22, 2023/dm
